title: 故宫
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (第一单元: 2 故宫 p. 12, 阅读 去北海公园滑冰 p. 19, 3 颐和园 p. 22) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第二课 runs pp. 12–21, 第三课 starts p. 22. 课堂练习 is pp. 15–18 (描一描写一写 and the first two rows of 读一读 15, the rest of 读一读 and 用一用 16, 扩展与替换/想一想 17, 对话/课堂游戏 18); the 阅读 text is pp. 19–20 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 21.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. The two 部首 are the blue boxes under the list on p. 14: 尸 → 居 and 殳 → 殿.

gloss.en: dynasty, as in 明朝 and 清朝

gloss.zh: 清朝的"清"；水很干净叫"清"
gloss.en: as in 清朝, the Qing dynasty; clear
imperial, as in 皇帝 and 皇宫

gloss.zh: 量词，客气地数人：一位老师、二十四位皇帝
gloss.en: polite measure word for people: 一位老师

gloss.zh: 又高又大的房子，皇帝住和办事的地方：宫殿、大殿
gloss.en: a palace hall, as in 宫殿

gloss.zh: 量词，数房间：一间房；也是房间的"间"
gloss.en: measure word for rooms: 一间房; as in 房间

gloss.zh: 放好、收起来，不让人看见：收藏、藏起来
gloss.en: hide, store away, as in 收藏

专有名词.section_note: Printed between 词语 and 句子 on p. 14, as in L03, with the pinyin capitalised as a name. Kept as the book has it; the lesson page may ignore it.

句子.zh: 以后有机会我还要来故宫逛逛。
句子.py: yǐ hòu yǒu jī huì wǒ hái yào lái gù gōng guàng guang.

where.zh: 课本第17页 扩展与替换

句型.pattern_note: The book prints no name for the pattern; 还要 is the part the 替换 table holds fixed (我还要) while the place and the doubled verb change, so it is named after that, as L03's ……终于…… was.
句型.substitutions_note: The blue 替换 table under the ladder on p. 17: 我还要 in red, then 来故宫 and 逛逛 underlined, and three rows that swap the two underlined parts. Added as the book prints it, as in L03 and L04.

读一读.page_break_note: rows 1–2 are at the foot of p. 15, under 描一描写一写; rows 3–6 at the top of p. 16, above 用一用. 居民 carries the pinyin mín above 民 in the book.

阅读.text_note: same copyright hold as the 课文. The margin of p. 19 prints ★ before each entry; 滑冰 and 适合 carry example phrases under them rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets. p. 21 carries the reading's 想一想，说一说 (four questions) and 日积月累 (临清风，对朗月，登山泛水，意酣歌。——（唐）李延寿), neither reproduced; the quotation is public domain.
